explication: Clawdmeter pairs an ESP32 usage dashboard with a host daemon: the daemon reads Claude credentials, polls usage, and sends updates over BLE; firmware renders usage and animations on the device. Windows adds a system-tray interface and login autostart. The firmware supports multiple Waveshare boards through a shared HAL. Several firmware subsystems are represented at their documented directory or module level because their implementation excerpts were not provided; uncertain connections are omitted or dashed.
